name: Pets
overview: Scripture reveals that God created all living creatures, including the animals upon the earth, and entrusted mankind with dominion over them, as seen in Genesis 1:24-28. While animals are part of God's creation and under His sovereign care (Genesis 9:2; Job 12:10), man is uniquely made in God's image and given authority over the creatures. The study of pets in relation to heaven considers God's design and the special role of humanity, recognizing the distinction between the souls of animals and humans.
